shloka_text: तथा तयोः संवदतोर्दुर्वासा भगवानृषिः । रामस्य दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी राजद्वारमुपागमत् ।। 7.105.1 ।।
transliteration: tathā tayoḥ saṃvadatordurvāsā bhagavānṛṣiḥ | rāmasya darśanākāṅkṣī rājadvāramupāgamat || 7.105.1 ||
translation: तथा thus, तयोः of those two, संवदतोः while conversing, दुर्वासा Durvasa, भगवान् revered, ऋषिः sage, रामस्य of Rama, दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी desiring the sight, राजद्वारम् royal gate, उपागमत् approached.
explanation: While those two were thus conversing, the revered sage Durvasa, desiring an audience with Rama, approached the royal gate.
comments: As they confer, the sage Durvasa arrives demanding instant audience and threatening to curse Rama's line if denied -- Lakshmana, choosing one life over all, breaks in to announce him, and Rama receives Durvasa, who asks only for food, eats and departs -- but, recalling Time's death-condition, Rama is overcome with grief for Lakshmana.

shloka_text: सो ऽभिगम्य तु सौमित्रिमुवाच ऋषिसत्तमः । रामं दर्शय मे शीघ्रं पुरा मे ऽर्थो ऽतिवर्तते ।। 7.105.2 ।।
transliteration: so 'bhigamya tu saumitrimuvāca ṛṣisattamaḥ | rāmaṃ darśaya me śīghraṃ purā me 'rtho 'tivartate || 7.105.2 ||
translation: सः he, अभिगम्य having approached, तु indeed, सौमित्रिम् to Saumitri, उवाच said, ऋषिसत्तमः the best of sages, रामम् Rama, दर्शय show, मे to me, शीघ्रम् quickly, पुरा before, मे my, अर्थः purpose, अतिवर्तते passes away.
explanation: Having approached Saumitri, the best of sages indeed said, "Show Rama to me quickly, before my purpose passes away."

shloka_text: मुनेस्तु भाषितं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा । अभिवाद्य महात्मानं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.105.3 ।।
transliteration: munestu bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā | abhivādya mahātmānaṃ vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.105.3 ||
translation: मुनेः of the sage, तु indeed, भाषितम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, परवीरहा destroyer of enemy heroes, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महात्मानम् the great-souled one, वाक्यम् words, एतत् this, उवाच said, ह indeed,
explanation: Having heard the words of the sage, Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemy heroes, saluted the great-souled one and then spoke these words.

shloka_text: किं कार्यं ब्रूहि भगवन्को वा ऽर्थः किं करोम्यहम् । व्यग्रो हि राघवो ब्रह्मन्मुहूर्तं प्रतिपाल्यताम् ।। 7.105.4 ।।
transliteration: kiṃ kāryaṃ brūhi bhagavanko vā 'rthaḥ kiṃ karomyaham | vyagro hi rāghavo brahmanmuhūrtaṃ pratipālyatām || 7.105.4 ||
translation: किम् what, कार्यम् task, ब्रूहि tell, भगवन् O revered one, कः what, वा or, अर्थः purpose, किम् what, करोमि shall I do, अहम् I, व्यग्रः busy, हि indeed, राघवः Rama, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, प्रतिपाल्यताम् let him be waited for,
explanation: Lakshmana asked, "O revered one, what is the task or purpose, and what shall I do, for Rama is indeed busy, O Brahmana, please wait for a moment."

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा ऋषिशार्दूलः क्रोधेन कलुषीकृतः । उवाच लक्ष्मणं वाक्यं निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा ।। 7.105.5 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā ṛṣiśārdūlaḥ krodhena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ | uvāca lakṣmaṇaṃ vākyaṃ nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā || 7.105.5 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, ऋषिशार्दूलः the tiger among sages, क्रोधेन by anger, कलुषीकृतः agitated, उवाच said, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, वाक्यम् words, निर्दहन् burning, इव as if, चक्षुषा with his eyes,
explanation: Having heard that, the tiger among sages, agitated by anger, spoke words to Lakshmana as if burning him with his eyes.

shloka_text: अस्मिन्क्षणे मां सौमित्रे रामाय प्रतिवेदय । अस्मिन्क्षणे मां सौमित्रे न निवेदयसे यदि ।। 7.105.6 ।।
transliteration: asminkṣaṇe māṃ saumitre rāmāya prativedaya | asminkṣaṇe māṃ saumitre na nivedayase yadi || 7.105.6 ||
translation: अस्मिन् in this, क्षणे moment, माम् me, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, रामाय to Rama, प्रतिवेदय announce, अस्मिन् in this, क्षणे moment, माम् me, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, न not, निवेदयसे you announce, यदि if,
explanation: The sage commanded, "O son of Sumitra, announce me to Rama this very moment; if you do not announce me to Rama this very moment, O son of Sumitra..."

shloka_text: विषयं त्वां पुरं चैव शपिष्ये राघवं तथा । भरतं चैव सौमित्रे युष्माकं या च सन्ततिः ।। 7.105.7 ।।
transliteration: viṣayaṃ tvāṃ puraṃ caiva śapiṣye rāghavaṃ tathā | bharataṃ caiva saumitre yuṣmākaṃ yā ca santatiḥ || 7.105.7 ||
translation: विषयम् the kingdom, त्वाम् you, पुरम् the city, च and, एव indeed, शपिष्ये I shall curse, राघवम् Rama, तथा and, भरतम् Bharata, च and, एव indeed, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, युष्माकम् your, या which, च and, सन्ततिः progeny,
explanation: ...then I shall curse your kingdom, you, the city, Rama, and also Bharata, O son of Sumitra, and all your progeny.

shloka_text: न हि शक्ष्याम्यहं भूयो मन्युं धारयितुं हृदि । तच्छ्रुत्वा घोरसङ्काशं वाक्यं तस्य महात्मनः । चिन्तयामास मनसा तस्य वाक्यस्य निश्चयम् ।। 7.105.8 ।।
transliteration: na hi śakṣyāmyahaṃ bhūyo manyuṃ dhārayituṃ hṛdi | tacchrutvā ghorasaṅkāśaṃ vākyaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ | cintayāmāsa manasā tasya vākyasya niścayam || 7.105.8 ||
translation: न not, हि indeed, शक्ष्यामि I shall be able, अहं I, भूयो again, मन्युं anger, धारयितुं to hold, हृदि in the heart, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, घोरसङ्काशं terrible-looking, वाक्यं word, तस्य of him, महात्मनः of the great soul, चिन्तयामास he thought, मनसा with the mind, तस्य of that, वाक्यस्य of the speech, निश्चयम् the certainty.
explanation: Having heard the terrible words of that great soul, he pondered in his mind the definite meaning of that statement, realizing he could no longer contain his anger.

shloka_text: एकस्य मरणं मे ऽस्तु मा भूत्सर्वविनाशनम् । इति बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य राघवाय न्यवेदयत् ।। 7.105.9 ।।
transliteration: ekasya maraṇaṃ me 'stu mā bhūtsarvavināśanam | iti buddhyā viniścitya rāghavāya nyavedayat || 7.105.9 ||
translation: एकस्य of one, मरणं death, मे for me, अस्तु let it be, मा not, भूत् let it be, सर्वविनाशनम् destruction of all, इति thus, बुद्ध्या with intellect, विनिश्चित्य having decided, राघवाय to Rama, न्यवेदयत् he reported.
explanation: Deciding with his intellect that it was better for one person to die than for everyone to be destroyed, he reported this to Rama.

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रामः कालं विसृज्य च । निस्सृत्य त्वरितं राजा अत्रेः पुत्रं ददर्श ह ।। 7.105.10 ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā rāmaḥ kālaṃ visṛjya ca | nissṛtya tvaritaṃ rājā atreḥ putraṃ dadarśa ha || 7.105.10 ||
translation: लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, कालं Kala, विसृज्य having dismissed, च and, निस्सृत्य having come out, त्वरितं quickly, राजा the king, अत्रेः of Atri, पुत्रं the son, ददर्श saw, ह indeed.
explanation: Having heard Lakshmana's words, King Rama dismissed Kala and quickly came out to see the son of Atri.

shloka_text: सो ऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा । किं कार्यमिति काकुत्स्थः कृताञ्जलिरभाषत ।। 7.105.11 ।।
transliteration: so 'bhivādya mahātmānaṃ jvalantamiva tejasā | kiṃ kāryamiti kākutsthaḥ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata || 7.105.11 ||
translation: सः he, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महात्मानं the great soul, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, इव as if, तेजसा with splendor, किं what, कार्यम् work, इति thus, काकुत्स्थः Rama, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, अभाषत spoke.
explanation: Having saluted the great soul who was blazing with splendor, Rama, with folded hands, asked what his purpose was.

shloka_text: तद्वाक्यं राघवेणोक्तं श्रुत्वा मुनिवरः प्रभुम् । प्रत्याह रामं दुर्वासाः श्रूयतां धर्मवत्सल ।। 7.105.12 ।।
transliteration: tadvākyaṃ rāghaveṇoktaṃ śrutvā munivaraḥ prabhum | pratyāha rāmaṃ durvāsāḥ śrūyatāṃ dharmavatsala || 7.105.12 ||
translation: तत् that, वाक्यं word, राघवेण by Rama, उक्तं spoken, श्रुत्वा having heard, मुनिवरः the best of sages, प्रभुम् to the lord, प्रत्याह replied, रामं to Rama, दुर्वासाः Durvasa, श्रूयतां let it be heard, धर्मवत्सल O lover of righteousness.
explanation: Having heard those words spoken by Rama, the best of sages, Durvasa, replied to the lord, saying, "O lover of righteousness, listen."

shloka_text: अद्य वर्षसहस्रस्य समाप्तिस्तपसो मम । सो ऽहं भोजनमिच्छामि यथासिद्धं तवानघ ।। 7.105.13 ।।
transliteration: adya varṣasahasrasya samāptistapaso mama | so 'haṃ bhojanamicchāmi yathāsiddhaṃ tavānagha || 7.105.13 ||
translation: अनघ O sinless one, अद्य today, मम my, वर्षसहस्रस्य of a thousand years, तपसः of penance, समाप्तिः is the completion, सः अहम् I therefore, यथासिद्धं whatever is ready, भोजनम् food, इच्छामि desire.
explanation: O sinless one, today marks the completion of my thousand-year penance, and so I desire whatever food is ready to break my fast.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं राजा राघवः प्रीतमानसः । भोजनं मुनिमुख्याय यथासिद्धमुपाहरत् ।। 7.105.14 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājā rāghavaḥ prītamānasaḥ | bhojanaṃ munimukhyāya yathāsiddhamupāharat || 7.105.14 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, वचनं word, राजा king, राघवः Rama, प्रीतमानसः with a pleased mind, भोजनं food, मुनिमुख्याय to the chief of sages, यथासिद्धम् as prepared, उपाहरत् offered.
explanation: Having heard that word, King Rama, with a pleased mind, offered food to the chief of sages as it was prepared.

shloka_text: स तु भुक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठस्तदन्नममृतोपमम् । साधु रामेति सम्भाष्य स्वमाश्रममुपागमत् ।। 7.105.15 ।।
transliteration: sa tu bhuktvā muniśreṣṭhastadannamamṛtopamam | sādhu rāmeti sambhāṣya svamāśramamupāgamat || 7.105.15 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, भुक्त्वा having eaten, मुनिश्रेष्ठः the best of sages, तत् that, अन्नम् food, अमृतोपमम् like nectar, साधु excellent, राम Rama, इति thus, सम्भाष्य having spoken, स्वम् his own, आश्रमम् hermitage, उपागमत् returned.
explanation: Having eaten that nectar-like food, the best of sages praised Rama saying "Excellent, Rama!" and then returned to his own hermitage.

shloka_text: तस्मिन् गते मुनिवरे स्वाश्रमं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः । संस्मृत्य कालवाक्यानि ततो दुःखमुपागमत् ।। 7.105.16 ।।
transliteration: tasmin gate munivare svāśramaṃ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ | saṃsmṛtya kālavākyāni tato duḥkhamupāgamat || 7.105.16 ||
translation: तस्मिन् when he, गते had gone, मुनिवरे the excellent sage, स्वम् his own, आश्रमम् hermitage, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः the elder brother of Lakshmana, संस्मृत्य having remembered, कालवाक्यानि the words of Kala, ततः then, दुःखम् sorrow, उपागमत् felt.
explanation: After that excellent sage had returned to his hermitage, Rama, the elder brother of Lakshmana, remembered the words of Kala and was then overcome with sorrow.

shloka_text: दुःखेन च सुसन्तप्तः स्मृत्वा तद्घोरदर्शनम् । अवाङ्मुखो दीनमना व्याहर्तुं न शशाक ह ।। 7.105.17 ।।
transliteration: duḥkhena ca susantaptaḥ smṛtvā tadghoradarśanam | avāṅmukho dīnamanā vyāhartuṃ na śaśāka ha || 7.105.17 ||
translation: दुःखेन by sorrow, च and, सुसन्तप्तः greatly afflicted, स्मृत्वा having remembered, तत् that, घोरदर्शनम् terrible sight, अवाङ्मुखः with downcast face, दीनमनाः with a dejected mind, व्याहर्तुं to speak, न not, शशाक was able, ह indeed.
explanation: Deeply distressed by sorrow and remembering that terrible sight, he became downcast and dejected, unable to utter a word.

shloka_text: ततो बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य कालवाक्यानि राघवः । नैतदस्तीति निश्चित्य तूष्णीमासीन्महायशाः ।। 7.105.18 ।।
transliteration: tato buddhyā viniścitya kālavākyāni rāghavaḥ | naitadastīti niścitya tūṣṇīmāsīnmahāyaśāḥ || 7.105.18 ||
translation: ततः then, बुद्ध्या by intellect, विनिश्चित्य having ascertained, कालवाक्यानि the words of Kala, राघवः Rama, न not, एतत् this, अस्ति is, इति thus, निश्चित्य having decided, तूष्णीम् silently, आसीत् remained, महायशाः the greatly renowned one.
explanation: Then, the greatly renowned Rama, having intellectually ascertained the words of Kala and deciding that "this is not (to be avoided)", remained silent. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 105 ।। Thus ends the hundred and fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
